Does the workflow ask clinicians what they think before showing the AI output?

What current clinical quality practices do for human-only care, the divergence records would do for human-AI care: recording both when an AI was used and the associated clinician decision-making; early evidence shows automated event-level AI logging may be feasible19.

unlisted_practices: Design clinical AI workflows to capture the clinician's independent assessment before showing the AI output.
Allow clinicians to record a disagreement with AI output rather than only dismiss it.
Record human-AI divergence events, including what each side contributed and how reconciliation occurred, rather than collapsing them into a single aggregate output.
Evaluate human-AI systems on whether the integrated system produced a better decision than either party alone, not on clinician agreement with the AI.
Do not ask patients to decide between conflicting clinical conclusions of the clinician and the AI.
